skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket price plus fees for all current bags under the current route, cabin, entitlement, weight, and size rules.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus every applicable current-bag fee.
outputs.name: answer

skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    ticket_price = inputs["ticket_price"]
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    carryon_caps = inputs["carryon_dimension_caps"]
    carryon_allowance = inputs["carryon_bag_allowance"]
    position_fees = inputs["checked_position_fees"]
    weight_mins = inputs["overweight_min_exclusive"]
    weight_maxs = inputs["overweight_max_inclusive"]
    weight_fees = inputs["overweight_fees"]
    size_mins = inputs["oversize_min_exclusive"]
    size_maxs = inputs["oversize_max_inclusive"]
    size_fees = inputs["oversize_fees"]
    bag_count = min(len(lengths), len(widths), len(heights), len(weights))
    carryons_used = 0
    checked_index = 0
    total = int(ticket_price)
    for i in range(bag_count):
        qualifies_as_carryon = False
        if carryons_used < carryon_allowance and len(carryon_caps) >= 3:
            qualifies_as_carryon = lengths[i] <= carryon_caps[0] and widths[i] <= carryon_caps[1] and heights[i] <= carryon_caps[2]
        if qualifies_as_carryon:
            carryons_used = carryons_used + 1
        else:
            base_fee = 0
            if len(position_fees) > 0:
                if checked_index < len(position_fees):
                    base_fee = position_fees[checked_index]
                else:
                    base_fee = position_fees[len(position_fees) - 1]
            overweight_fee = 0
            weight_band_count = min(len(weight_mins), len(weight_maxs), len(weight_fees))
            for j in range(weight_band_count):
                if weights[i] > weight_mins[j] and weights[i] <= weight_maxs[j]:
                    overweight_fee = max(overweight_fee, weight_fees[j])
            linear_size = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            oversize_fee = 0
            size_band_count = min(len(size_mins), len(size_maxs), len(size_fees))
            for j in range(size_band_count):
                if linear_size > size_mins[j] and linear_size <= size_maxs[j]:
                    oversize_fee = max(oversize_fee, size_fees[j])
            total = total + int(base_fee) + int(max(overweight_fee, oversize_fee))
            checked_index = checked_index + 1
    return {"answer": int(total)}

origin.quote: You can bring only one carry-on item along with your personal item. Your carry-on must fit in in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you. If it doesn't fit, it will need to be checked.

source_obligations.statement: In manifest order, exclude no more than the allowed number of bags satisfying every carry-on dimension cap before assigning checked-bag positions.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For a checked bag that is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher of those two excess fees to its checked-position fee.
